name: throwable-highlighter-vscode-prototype
description: Technical prototype of Throwable Highlighter for VS Code.

commands.title: Throwable Highlighter Prototype: Open Color Settings

throwableHighlighter.prototype.classColo.description: Stored foreground color for Throwable types in the class context. Custom sources require HEX. With no explicit source, an empty value preserves native Java highlighting.

throwableHighlighter.prototype.importCol.description: Stored foreground color for Throwable types in explicit imports. Custom sources require HEX. With no explicit source, an empty value inherits the class color.

throwableHighlighter.prototype.catchColo.description: Stored foreground color for Throwable types in catch parameters. Custom sources require HEX. With no explicit source, an empty value inherits the class color.

throwableHighlighter.prototype.throwsCol.description: Stored foreground color for Throwable types in throws clauses. Custom sources require HEX. With no explicit source, an empty value inherits the class color.

throwableHighlighter.prototype.classColo.description: Color source for Throwable types in the class context. Null preserves the existing classColor rules.

throwableHighlighter.prototype.importCol.description: Color source for Throwable types in explicit imports. Null preserves the existing importColor rules.

throwableHighlighter.prototype.catchColo.description: Color source for Throwable types in catch parameters. Null preserves the existing catchColor rules.

throwableHighlighter.prototype.throwsCol.description: Color source for Throwable types in throws clauses. Null preserves the existing throwsColor rules.

scripts.test: npm run test:build && npm run compile:test && node --test "out-test/test/**/*.test.js"
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run compile && npm test
scripts.check:local: npm run format:check:changed && npm run compile && npm test
